acceptanceCriteria: The test no longer fails on a slow host when every export succeeds; the writer stays active until at least the required number of exports overlapped it (or equivalent deterministic overlap).
The CTS-V0-006 concurrent-writer proof is not weakened: exports still overlap real commits and every archive verifies.
go test -count=20 -run TestCTSV0006_ArchiveExportUnderConcurrentWriter ./internal/tasks/archive passes under parallel load.
body: Observed 2026-10-16 in a focused run (internal/tasks/archive, 69.3s, host load 30-60): read_wait_test.go:66 "only 3 exports ran; the writer finished before they exercised it"; quiet export 122ms. The test requires >=5 exports while an 8-commit writer (10ms work, 150ms window) runs; under load each export+Verify is slower so fewer fit, failing with no product defect. All exports succeeded (no REDO_PENDING/SNAPSHOT_MOVED). Suspected test flake, not a confirmed product bug. Expected: the coverage floor is defined relative to writer duration (e.g. keep the writer running until N exports have overlapped it, or stop the writer after the exports complete) so the CTS-V0-006 concurrency proof holds independent of host speed.
title: TestCTSV0006_ArchiveExportUnderConcurrentWriter fails under host load: 'only 3 exports ran' (load-sensitive count floor)
